{'胡志偉接受美聯社訪問表示，他赴英跟家人見面，他擔憂其刑事記錄會影響入境，事前曾跟英國領事館溝通，但上周三到達倫敦的機場時，邊防部門的人員認為他可能有目的，包括尋求長期居留。胡志偉指他最終獲准入境，當局准許他「保釋入境」七天，他要在本周三（29日）離開英國。他本來打算今次跟家人共渡數月。他又表示，擔心入境記錄，會影響他將來的旅程，希望英國內政部延長他的逗留日子。': 'Wu Chi-wai told the Associated Press that he travelled to the UK to see his family and was worried his criminal record would affect his entry. He had previously communicated with the British consulate, but when he arrived at a London airport last Wednesday, border officials suspected he might have an ulterior motive, including seeking long-term residence. Wu said he was eventually allowed entry, with authorities granting him "bail to enter" for seven days, requiring him to leave the UK this Wednesday (29th). He had originally planned to spend several months with his family this time. He also expressed concern that the entry record would affect his future travels and hoped the UK Home Office would extend his stay.'}

{'他說：「我十分擔心，自己是否有能力或機會，再次獲準進入英國，與家人團聚」。英國內政部指，一般不會評論個別個案，政府堅定支持身在英國的香港人。': 'He said: "I am very worried about whether I will have the ability or opportunity to be allowed to enter the UK again to reunite with my family." The UK Home Office said it would not normally comment on individual cases, and that the government firmly supports Hong Kong people in the UK.'}

{'美聯社引述胡志偉否認他向英國尋求庇護，但他指長遠計劃是跟在英家人團聚。他也關注香港人面對類似的邊境問題。他指自己有回程機票，原訂計劃在 11 月回港，已改為周三回港，但非由他作更改。英國內政部及航空公司沒回覆美聯社的查詢。': "The Associated Press quoted Wu Chi-wai as denying he was seeking asylum in the UK, but he said his long-term plan was to reunite with his family in the UK. He is also concerned about Hong Kong people facing similar border issues. He said he had a return ticket and originally planned to return to Hong Kong in November, but this was changed to Wednesday, though not by his doing. The UK Home Office and airlines did not respond to the Associated Press's enquiries."}

{'前民主黨主席胡志偉，本月 21 日晚由香港赴英，在希斯路機場被扣留，英國《泰晤士報》上周報道，他將在七天內，被驅逐出境遣返。胡志偉在 47 人案被判囚 4 年 5 個月，他在 6 月 30 日判滿獲釋。': 'Former Democratic Party chairman Wu Chi-wai travelled from Hong Kong to the UK on the evening of the 21st of this month and was detained at Heathrow Airport. The Times of London reported last week that he would be deported within seven days. Wu was sentenced to 4 years and 5 months in prison in the 47 Defendants case and was released upon completing his sentence on June 30.'}
